brief:
Israeli forces injured 11 Palestinians, including four children, during a military incursion into the town of Tubas in the northern West Bank, the Shehab Wire reported. The operation resulted in multiple civilian casualties, with medics treating wounded residents at local clinics following the raid.

The circumstances that prompted the Israeli military operation were not immediately clear. Tubas, located in the Jordan Valley region, has faced repeated incursions by Israeli forces in recent months. The town's health facilities received the injured residents in the hours following the raid.
